tagline: Advancing sustainable manufacturing through additive manufacturing, recycled polymers, polymer composites, polymer coatings, digital twins, and machine learning-driven process optimization.
department: Department of Mechanical Engineering · KFUPM · Dhahran, Saudi Arabia

about.text: The Sustainable Polymer Manufacturing Group focuses on developing environmentally responsible polymer manufacturing technologies. Our work combines additive manufacturing, polymer recycling, high-performance composites, polymer coating, advanced characterization, and artificial intelligence to support circular and smart manufacturing.

collaborate.intro: We work with academic and industrial partners on sustainable polymer manufacturing, from recycled feedstock development to printing, testing and data-driven optimization. If your work involves polymers, additive manufacturing or manufacturing data, we would be glad to talk.

expertise.title: High-temperature and composite printing
expertise.text: Printing and characterizing PEEK, PEI and carbon- or glass-fiber reinforced grades for demanding applications.

expertise.title: Recycled feedstocks
expertise.text: Turning post-consumer and post-industrial polymers into filament and pellets, with drying and extrusion in-house.

expertise.title: Mechanical and dimensional characterization
expertise.text: Full-field strain measurement with digital image correlation, optical microscopy, and 3D scanning of printed parts.

expertise.title: Machine learning and digital twins
expertise.text: Process–structure–property models, defect prediction, and optimization of manufacturing parameters.

expertise.title: Coatings and surface engineering
expertise.text: Coating and surface-texturing strategies for adhesion, wear resistance and durability.

ways: Joint research projects and funding proposals
Industry-sponsored studies on materials and processes
Prototyping and testing on our equipment, by arrangement

join.intro: We welcome motivated MS and PhD applicants, postdoctoral researchers and undergraduate students who want to work on sustainable manufacturing with real machines and real data.
looking_for: A degree in mechanical, materials, manufacturing, chemical or polymer engineering, or a related field
Interest in additive manufacturing, polymers, recycling or data-driven manufacturing
Hands-on curiosity: you enjoy designing experiments and building things
Clear scientific writing in English, or the drive to develop it
join.how_to_apply: Graduate applications go through KFUPM's admissions process. Before applying, email Dr. Yassmin Seid Ahmed with your CV, transcripts, and a short note (about one page) on the research you would like to do in the group.
